part.text:
P0 | seg_origin_run.py: `ORIGIN = 300` / `_init_origin` (`self.closed = ORIGIN`) | `MiceV1.step` stores `X[self.closed:self.closed+self.seg]`, so `closed` is the first row of the first segment; ORIGIN=300 yields segments [300+500k, 800+500k), not the registered [200+500k, 700+500k). With b=500 the first segment [300,800) crosses the concept boundary at 700; with b=2000 [1800,2300) crosses the boundary at 2200; rows 200–299 enter no segment although the registration puts only the 200 prefix rows outside segments. P is therefore not the registered pure-segment policy, so H1–H3 do not test the registered condition (and the comment "first segment closes at row ORIGIN + seg" itself implies ORIGIN=200). | Set `ORIGIN = 200` (first segment [200,700), closing at row 700).
P0 | check_seg_origin.py: contrast loop, `r[f"C_hist{k}"]` (both `""` and `"_rec5"`) | `C_hist` is computed as `P_d_ddm - O_d_ddm`, i.e. identical to `C_imp`; the registration defines C_hist = P - A on matched batches (`P_d_ddm - A_d_ddm`), as the file's own docstring ("the prefix effect … under restored phase") also states. Both C_hist columns of `seg_origin.csv` and the H3 verdict therefore simply repeat C_imp. | Compute `r[f"C_hist{k}"] = r[f"P_d_ddm{k}"] - r[f"A_d_ddm{k}"]`.
P0 | check_seg_origin.py: `P=policies(f"{RUN}/P", f"{RUN}/P", f"{CTRL}/off", of, t + 1)` | Matched batches are registered as offset batch t+2 = aligned batch t (SHIFT=2, as in 4.b) and O is loaded with `t + SHIFT`; P is loaded with `t + 1`, one batch earlier. Then `pol["O"]["ddm"] = acc[t+2]` while `pol["P"]["ddm"] = acc[t+1]`, so `assert np.array_equal(pol["O"]["ddm"], pol["P"]["ddm"])` cannot pass (the script aborts before writing the CSV), and C_imp, H1 and the rec5 windows would mix unmatched batches (rec mask also labels the wrong batches for P). | Pass `t + SHIFT` (t+2) for P, the same matched batches as O.
P0 | check_seg_origin.py: H1 verdict `{'HOLDS' if pos >= 6 and mean >= 1.0 else 'FAILS'}` | Registered H1 (and the same line's printed "(>= 7)") requires MICE−DDM positive on ≥ 7 of 8 streams — the frozen 4.b criterion — but the verdict tests `pos >= 6`, silently relaxing the registered threshold so H1 can be reported HOLDS with only 6/8 positive. | Use `pos >= 7` in the HOLDS test.
P1 | check_seg_origin.py: H3 verdict `m.C_hist.abs().mean() <= 1.0` | Registered H3 is |mean C_hist| ≤ 1.0 (absolute value of the 8-stream mean); the code tests the mean of absolute values, which is ≥ |mean| and can flip FAILS/HOLDS, and the same line prints `m.C_hist.mean()`, so the reported statistic and the verdict disagree. | Test `abs(m.C_hist.mean()) <= 1.0`.
